map.质量验收抽样：基于计数标准型抽样检验，输入批量 N、样本 n、合格判定数 Ac: Quality acceptance sampling: based on counting standard sampling inspection, enter lot N, sample n, accept number Ac and found defectives d, judge lot accept/reject per GB/T 2828 or AQL, for incoming/final inspection.
map.💡 判定规则：d ≤ Ac 接收批，d > Ac 拒收批。接收概率基于二项分布: Tip: Decision rule: d <= Ac accept lot, d > Ac reject lot. Acceptance probability by binomial P(d<=Ac)=Sum C(n,i) p^i (1-p)^(n-i), i=0 to Ac. LTPD is the defective rate when acceptance probability = 10%.
map.样本数 n 应小于或等于批量 N，通常 n ≤ N 的 10%（大批量时）: Sample size n should be <= lot N, usually n <= 10% of N (for large lots).
map.AQL 是使用方愿意接受的最大过程平均不合格品率，常用值 0.65%、1.0%、: AQL is the max process-average defective rate the user is willing to accept; common 0.65%, 1.0%, 1.5%, 2.5%.
map.LTPD（批容许不合格品率）是生产方风险 β=10% 时对应的不合格品率: LTPD (lot tolerance defective rate) is the defective rate at producer risk beta=10%.
map.当 n/N > 0.1 时建议使用超几何分布，本工具采用二项分布近似: When n/N > 0.1, hypergeometric is suggested; this tool uses the binomial approximation.

map.方案评价：算 AQL 处接收概率与生产方风险，评估抽样方案宽严: Plan evaluation: compute acceptance probability at AQL and producer risk, assess plan strictness.
map.质量分析：算 LTPD 与样本不合格率，判断过程质量水平: Quality analysis: compute LTPD and sample defective rate, judge process quality level.
map.接收概率 Pa(n, Ac, p) = Σ(i=0..Ac) C(n,i) pⁱ: acceptance probability Pa(n, Ac, p) = Sum(i=0..Ac) C(n,i) p^i (1-p)^(n-i); acceptance probability at AQL = Pa(n, Ac, AQL); producer risk alpha = 1 - Pa (prob of rejecting a good lot); LTPD solved by bisection for Pa = 0.10 (quality level at user risk beta=10%); sample defective rate = d/n times 100%; when d <= Ac accept. Plan evaluation: Pa >=0.95 excellent (low alpha), >=0.90 good, >=0.80 fair, else poor, optimize.
map.例：批量 1000、样本 80、Ac=2、发现 d=1、AQL 1.0% → A: Example: lot 1000, sample 80, Ac=2, found d=1, AQL 1.0% -> acceptance at AQL 95.3%, producer risk alpha=4.7%, LTPD 6.52%, sample defective 1.25%, sampling ratio 8.0%, verdict: lot accept (qualified), plan evaluation excellent (alpha=4.7%), but sample defective 1.25% exceeds AQL 1.0%, warning process not up to standard. If d=3 -> 3>Ac=2, verdict: lot reject (unqualified), sample defective 3.75%. If Ac tightened to 1 (n=80, AQL 1.0%) -> acceptance drops to 80.9%, alpha rises to 19.1%, plan down to fair.
map.生产方风险和使用方风险分别是什么？: What are producer risk and consumer risk respectively?
map.生产方风险 α 是把质量合格的批（不合格品率 ≤ AQL）误判为不合格的概率，损: Producer risk alpha is the probability of wrongly rejecting a good lot (defective <= AQL), hurting the supplier; consumer risk beta is the probability of wrongly accepting a bad lot (defective >= LTPD), hurting the buyer. A standard sampling plan aims to keep alpha around 5% and beta around 10%; this tool computes exactly at these two points.
map.为什么二项分布就够了，不用: Why is the binomial enough, without
map.当批量 N 远大于样本量 n（一般 n/N < 0.1）时，不放回抽样可用二项分: When lot N is much larger than sample n (generally n/N < 0.1), sampling without replacement is well approximated by the binomial, error negligible. This tool default example n/N = 80/1000 = 8%, approximation holds. If N is small (e.g. N=50, n=20), use the hypergeometric instead, otherwise acceptance probability is overestimated. For formal plans follow GB/T 2828.1 transfer rules and sampling tables.
